untouchedSurfaces: Mobile/Auth/Admin/AI/credits/DNS, old QA data and existing SQL migration history remain unchanged.

impact.dataWrite: Local source/packet plus synthetic isolated PostgreSQL only. Proposed managed write stores normalized email/locale/interest/UTM/consent, but this preparation performs no managed write.
impact.backendContract: Existing register_marketing_waitlist_request service-only RPC and generic 202 accepted; typed dependency-injected HTTP handler for complete local integration.
impact.adminVisibility: Existing aggregate model compatible, no subscriber PII exported. Admin stays on legacy target until separate approved retarget.
impact.privacySafety: Explicit consent unchecked, bounded payload, private table/RPC grants, fail-closed CAPTCHA/hostname, no address enumeration or outbound messages.
impact.observability: Coarse success analytics only; sanitized verification receipts, no emails/tokens/provider secrets in logs.
impact.rollback: Keep current production 48bd27bf; server errors leave input for retry, widget reset. Cloud deployment blocked until target/secret/recovery acceptance.
impact.localTesting: Bind dev server to IPv4 loopback only for authorized Android ADB forwarding; no LAN/public listener.

securityReview.authzRls: RPC is service-only invoker; anon/auth cannot access contact tables or sequences. Native tests cover all table privileges, role paths and rollback.
securityReview.sensitiveData: Only .example synthetic email inputs in isolated local tests; never read/export old QA subscriber PII or create managed contacts.
securityReview.secretsLogging: No secret values in build/packet. Public endpoint/site key separate from server service role/Turnstile secret. Logs record sanitized codes only.
securityReview.externalInput: Reject JSON null/array, invalid/oversize content, origin mismatch, missing consent or CAPTCHA; UTM allowlist bounds; no script execution of user text.
securityReview.dependencies: Existing pinned SDK and PostgreSQL image; test injection only in local driver, no production bypass or test secrets in release artifacts.
securityReview.migrationRelease: Local-only preparation; managed target inventory freshly read. Empty release allowlist/production and recovery gates stay blocked, no db push/repair or project bootstrap.
securityReview.stopCondition: Stop cloud execution while managed SQL/target/credential/widget/recovery acceptance missing; stop local candidate on failed tests, private data or unidentified dependencies.
